exam_scheme.note: Admission to the 4-year Bachelor of Design (B.Des) programme across National Institute of Design campuses (NID Ahmedabad, NID Andhra Pradesh, NID Haryana, NID Madhya Pradesh, and NID Assam) is conducted via a two-tier Design Aptitude Test (DAT). Stage 1 is DAT Prelims, a 3-hour pen-and-paper examination consisting of Objective/MCQ questions (Part I) and subjective drawing/design aptitude questions (Part II) evaluated out of 100 marks. Stage 2 is DAT Mains, comprising hands-on studio tests and material handling for candidates shortlisted from Prelims (approx 3 times the vacancies per category). Final merit for B.Des is computed with 40% weightage to DAT Prelims and 60% weightage to DAT Mains.
